title: Signed Cancellation Requests and the Requested Cancellation Date — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Signing a cancellation request on NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

A cancellation of an NFIP Dwelling Form policy rests on a cancellation request signed by the named insured, stating the reason, the document supplied with it and the date the cancellation is to take effect. This schedule governs the requested cancellation date of a request the named insured signs under `REPLACED_BY_PRIVATE_FLOOD` because a Tidemark HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy recorded as replacing this policy took effect.

**Effect of signing.** One signed cancellation request is put on file for the policy, carrying the reason, the document the insured supplies with it and the date the cancellation is to take effect; the request is recorded as signed, with no lender release on file, and nothing on the policy itself changes.

### `sign_cancellation_request_cbba569e` — the customer's own step

Signing is the named insured disposing of their own contract, so `sign_cancellation_request_cbba569e` belongs to the customer: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

- `dwelling_policy_id` — the reference number of the NFIP Dwelling Form policy to be cancelled, as given to the insured by the representative from the policy lookup.
- `cancellation_reason` — the reason on the request, one of: `BUILDING_SOLD` (the insured building was sold); `BUILDING_REMOVED_OR_DEMOLISHED` (it was removed or demolished); `CONTENTS_SOLD_OR_REMOVED` (a contents-only policy's contents left the premises); `DUPLICATE_NFIP_POLICY` (another NFIP policy covers the same property); `CLOSING_DID_NOT_OCCUR` (the loan the policy was bought for never closed); `REMOVED_FROM_SFHA_BY_LOMA_LOMR` (a FEMA letter removed the building from the Special Flood Hazard Area); `MORTGAGE_PAID_OFF` (the loan requiring the coverage was paid off); `VOLUNTARY_NOT_REQUIRED` (the insured no longer wants coverage that no lender requires); `REPLACED_BY_PRIVATE_FLOOD` (a private flood policy replaced this policy); `NO_INSURABLE_INTEREST` (the insured never had an interest in the property); `INELIGIBLE_PROPERTY` (the property was never insurable); `PREMIUM_PAYMENT_DISHONORED` (the application premium was dishonored); `NONE` (no reason applies — never the case on a signed cancellation).
- `supporting_document` — the document supplied with the request, one of: `CLOSING_DISCLOSURE` (a sale's closing disclosure or settlement statement); `REMOVAL_EVIDENCE` (proof the building was removed); `OTHER_NFIP_DECLARATIONS` (another NFIP policy's declarations); `LENDER_LOAN_NOT_CLOSED_STATEMENT` (the lender's statement that the loan did not close); `LOMA_LOMR_LETTER` (a FEMA letter of map amendment or revision); `PAYOFF_LETTER` (a loan payoff letter); `PRIVATE_FLOOD_DECLARATIONS` (the replacing private flood policy's declarations); `NONE` (no document supplied).
- `requested_effective_date` — the date the cancellation takes effect, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time zone).

**Return.** "Cancellation request <request reference> signed for policy <policy reference>: reason <reason>, document <document>, effective <YYYY-MM-DD>." The request reference identifies the signed request on file.
